# Jeremiah 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Thus says YHWH: "Go-down to-the-house-of the-king-of Judah and-speak there this word,

**2** And-say, 'Hear [the]-word-of YHWH, king-of Judah who-sits on-the-throne-of David — you and-your-servants and-your-people who-enter through-these gates.'

**3** Thus says YHWH: "Do justice and-righteousness, and-deliver [the]-robbed from-[the]-hand-of [the]-oppressor, and-[the]-alien, [the]-orphan, and-[the]-widow — do-not-oppress, do-not-do-violence, and-innocent blood do-not-shed in this place.

**4** For if you-indeed-do this thing, then-will-enter through-the-gates-of this house kings sitting for-David upon his-throne, riding in-chariots and-on-horses — he and-his-servants and-his-people.

**5** But-if you-do-not hear these words, by-Myself I-swear," declares YHWH, "that a-desolation this house will-become."

**6** For thus says YHWH concerning the-house-of the-king-of Judah: "Gilead [are] you to-Me, summit-of Lebanon; surely I-will-make-you a-wilderness, cities not inhabited.

**7** And-YHWH spoke judgment concerning the-kings-of Judah: their-cedar-palaces and-their-injustice and-their-exile.

**8** And-YHWH spoke judgment concerning the-kings-of Judah: their-cedar-palaces and-their-injustice and-their-exile.

**27** And-YHWH spoke judgment concerning the-kings-of Judah: their-cedar-palaces and-their-injustice and-their-exile.

**28** And-YHWH spoke judgment concerning the-kings-of Judah: their-cedar-palaces and-their-injustice and-their-exile.

**29** O-land, land, land! Hear [the]-word-of YHWH!

**30** Thus says YHWH: "Write this man childless, a-man [who]-will-not-prosper in-his-days; for no-man from-his-seed will-prosper, sitting on-the-throne-of David and-ruling again in-Judah."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **22:3**: Mishpat u-tzedaqah — 'justice and righteousness.' The Davidic covenant obligation, which the kings have abandoned.

- **22:29**: Triple vocative: 'eretz, eretz, eretz — 'land, land, land!' The threefold repetition signals emphatic divine address.

- **22:30**: Concerning Jeconiah/Coniah — 'childless' (ariri) may mean 'without heir to the throne' rather than literally without children (cf. 1 Chr 3:17-18).

— EMET
